subject: Temporary no-PO path for CloudWave pilot — onboarding approvals
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudwave.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Quick pilot — procurement lead time and PO question

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to run a short pilot of Redwood Inference for our internal search relevance work. We have an internal procurement cadence that usually requires a 6-8 week onboarding and a PO before any vendor can be paid. That timeline will push our pilot out past the quarter, which would be a bummer.

Would Redwood consider a temporary "no-PO" path for a 30-day pilot (estimated spend ~$6k) while CloudWave completes vendor onboarding? We can sign your standard SOW or an NDA (attached) and fill out any onboarding forms you need.

I've attached our onboarding form as well in case that helps speed things up. Happy to hop on a 15-min call if it would help.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Procurement
CloudWave Inc.
Attachments: CloudWave_Onboarding_Form.pdf
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudwave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-30T10:01:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick pilot — procurement lead time and PO question

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and for the materials.

We can potentially support a short-term no-PO pilot if we lock in a few controls on our side:
- Pilot scope capped at $8k for 30 days
- Red team review of the onboarding form + signed NDA (we got the NDA you attached)
- Invoicing to invoices@redwood.ai with the waiver ID in the subject line

Looping in Marissa (procurement intake) and Marcus (finance) to confirm the temporary approval path and any paperwork we need to finalize. Kar (cc'd) will help with the vendor intake checklist.

If you can return the completed onboarding form and the NDA countersigned, we'll start internal approvals today and aim to get back with a provisional waiver by EOD tomorrow.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudwave.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-30T13:24:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick pilot — procurement lead time and PO question

Hi all,

Thanks, Naomi. Quick checklist from procurement side so we can evaluate the exception: 
- Completed vendor onboarding form (company info, tax IDs, insurance) — please submit via our intake link or reply with the form (I see one attached from Lena, will verify).
- Signed NDA (we need Redwood's countersign) — Lena, if you can send the signed copy we can countersign today.
- Business justification for no-PO (pilot urgency, expected MRR if successful, and spend cap).

For exceptions we require written manager approval and a provisional waiver form filled out; I'm attaching our provisional PO waiver template (Provisional_PO_waiver-form.pdf). The standard approval window is 30 days and spend must be tracked through the temporary vendor code.

A couple of notes on risk: we will not route long-running production bills on this waiver; any production traffic after the pilot must have a PO.

Thanks — once we have the completed form and NDA, I will route to my manager for a sign-off.

—Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Provisional_PO_waiver-form.pdf
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudwave.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudwave.com
Date: 2027-05-30T15:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick pilot — procurement lead time and PO question

Marissa — thanks, attached are the completed onboarding form and the signed NDA (CloudWave_NDA_signed.pdf).

A quick justification for the exception: the pilot is a technical evaluation tied to a potential $120k ARR opportunity if we proceed to production. The internal team requests a hands-on 30-day pilot to validate latency/cost under real queries. We will not route production usage to Redwood during the pilot.

We completed the provisional waiver form with the requested caps and returned it here. Happy to provide any additional company docs (W9, insurance cert) if needed.

Lena

Naomi / Marissa — reviewed the submitted docs (onboarding form, NDA, waiver). Given the deal economics and the signed NDA, finance will approve a provisional no-PO vendor path for a single 30-day pilot with the following conditions: 

1) Spend cap: $8,000 total for the pilot period; finance will refuse charges beyond this cap unless a PO is provided.
2) Invoice routing: CloudWave to invoice Redwood at invoices@redwood.ai and include waiver ID RW-2027-CLDW-01 in the subject line.
3) Accounting controls: Procurement to create a temporary vendor code; GL owner will be Product Ops.
4) Reporting: Naomi please send a weekly usage-and-cost snapshot to marcus_lin@redwood.ai during the pilot.

Once procurement creates the temporary vendor code and we receive the countersigned NDA in our records, I'll mark this approved and finance will process the first invoice under the waiver.

Marcus Lin
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudwave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-31T17:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick pilot — procurement lead time and PO question

Lena — great, we're all set to move forward. Summary of next steps: 

- Procurement (Marissa) will create the temp vendor code by EOD and confirm waiver ID RW-2027-CLDW-01.
- Finance (Marcus) has approved the provisional no-PO path for up to $8k for 30 days.
- CloudWave to send invoices to invoices@redwood.ai with waiver ID in the subject.
- Naomi will send a weekly usage & cost snapshot (first report Monday).
- Pilot start target: Tuesday, 2027-06-01 (once temp vendor code is active).

Thanks for the quick turnaround from your side — Lena. Please upload any additional legal or tax docs to the onboarding Drive link so procurement can close the file.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
